_comment: CAMP-118. The project's scope, in ONE machine-readable place. Read by apps/api/src/osm/eu.ts at runtime, and by scripts/ci/check-eu-scope.mjs and scripts/osm-pipeline/drop-non-eu.mjs directly. It is JSON and not TypeScript because the shell-side tools used to recover this list by running a regex over eu.ts, and a regex silently returned a SHORTER list when one entry was written with double quotes — which prettier's default does. A short list turns drop-non-eu.mjs into 'delete that country'; review demonstrated it deleting France. JSON cannot be misparsed by accident.
_warning: Twenty-seven is a fact about 2026, not a constant. When the Union changes, change this file; every consumer reads it.
